message: Campaign c-20261011-005421-d315 starting: 5 rounds (auto, auto, auto, auto, auto).

Chaos Planner — LLM agent (groq/openai/gpt-oss-120b) chose network_partition on order-service: First-time network partition on high‑impact order-service, affecting the critical api-gateway and exposing recovery paths for dependent services.
GO: order-service at 2/2 Ready, system 100% healthy. Blast radius: 1 dependent service(s) ['api-gateway'], ~100% of users, risk MEDIUM.
Injected network_partition into order-service: Deny-all NetworkPolicy selecting the service's pods (chaos-isolate-order-service).

Anomaly confirmed on api-gateway 10s after injection: pattern matches high latency. Isolation Forest score +0.013 (threshold +0.103), severity 0.92. Evidence: p99_latency_ms=8797.37ms vs baseline 242.46ms (z=+25.0); caller_p99_ms=243.30ms vs baseline 242.66ms (z=+0.0). LSTM forecast for the next 60s: score +0.009 (still anomalous).

Root cause localised to order-service (network partition, confidence 95%). api-gateway also deviate as callers of order-service: its failure propagates to them. notification-service also deviate without a dependency explaining it (lower-ranked candidates). Change evidence: NetworkPolicy 'chaos-isolate-order-service' denies all Ingress/Egress traffic for pods of order-service, created 16s ago; 2 ERROR log lines in the last 60s, e.g. 'dependency failure (product-service)'.

Confidence in network_policy_rollback: 0.61 (prior 0.70 (no history yet) x RCA 0.95 x blast factor 0.93). Decision: network_policy_rollback on order-service (fallback rolling_restart, confidence 0.61).
Executing network_policy_rollback on order-service.
network_policy_rollback succeeded in 2.0s — removed 1 isolating NetworkPolicy(ies): chaos-isolate-order-service.
order-service verified functional: 2/2 replicas Ready and 5 consecutive user-path probes OK (last 7ms).
Round teardown for order-service: no residual fault found; autoscaler returned to declared bounds.

order-service recovered: detected in 9.83s, mitigated in 10.59s, fully back to its normal operating band in 40.0s (target 90s — MET). Users saw 102 failed requests out of 992 (10.3%) during the incident.
